reviews.title: Excellent Value
reviews.body: This laptop is an excellent setup for the cost. The processor is very fast; graphics are great. Battery life is excellent; used the laptop for several hours and still had greater than 50% time left before charging it was necessary. Price comparison of this HP laptop ($500) with Apple MacBook ($1750)
reviews.excerpt: Price comparison of this HP laptop ($500) with Apple MacBook ($1750) is 30% of total cost.
